gaps.detail: Changes nothing scored. Re-opened PMID 19874220 (Cao/Yao 2009, China Pharmaceutical University): PEG-CIFN dosed to rhesus at 150-1250 ug/kg for an ELISA validation; it never names IFN-SA or Fagen. Zheng 2014 (PMC4386949) cites it as ref 15 only among 'branched PEG-proteins' references, while PEG-IFN-SA is a 20 kDa linear mPEG-ALD N-terminal conjugate from Chongqing Fagen first described by Cai 2011. Not the same product, so model_first_use_year 2011 stands.
